SQL_fingerprints.sql: SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.src = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.dst = f0.id)) AND (e1.arch_type = $2 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $3 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)) AND (n1.root_id = CAST($4 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($5 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($4 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

INSERT INTO anchors
                (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
                 src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, version, updated_at)
            VALUES
            (CAST($1 AS uuid), $2, $3, $4, $5, CAST($6 AS uuid), CAST($7 AS uuid), CAST($8 AS uuid), $9, CAST($10 AS jsonb), $11, $12, now())
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
                arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
                arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
                fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
                root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
                src = EXCLUDED.src,
                dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
                undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
                props = EXCLUDED.props,
                format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
                version = EXCLUDED.version + 1,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE anchors.version = EXCLUDED.version
            RETURNING id, version
INSERT INTO graph_types (type_name, ancestor) VALUES ($1, $2), ($3, $4), ($5, $6) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.src = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.dst = f0.id)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $2 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) AND (n1.root_id = CAST($3 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($4 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($3 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id = $1
INSERT INTO graph_types (type_name, ancestor) VALUES ($1, $2), ($3, $4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

                (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
                 src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, version, updated_at)
            VALUES
            (CAST($1 AS uuid), $2, $3, $4, $5, CAST($6 AS uuid), CAST($7 AS uuid), CAST($8 AS uuid), $9, CAST($10 AS jsonb), $11, $12, now()),
(CAST($13 AS uuid), $14, $15, $16, $17, CAST($18 AS uuid), CAST($19 AS uuid), CAST($20 AS uuid), $21, CAST($22 AS jsonb), $23, $24, now())
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
                arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
                arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
                fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
                root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
                src = EXCLUDED.src,
                dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
                undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
                props = EXCLUDED.props,
                format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
                version = EXCLUDED.version + 1,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE anchors.version = EXCLUDED.version
            RETURNING id, version
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT n1.id, e1.id FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) WITH ORDINALITY AS f0(id, ord) LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND (e1.dst = f0.id OR (e1.undirected AND e1.src = f0.id)) AND (e1.arch_type = $2 OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $2)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = $3 OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = $3)) AND (n1.root_id = CAST($4 AS uuid) OR (n1.props->'access'->>'all')::int > -1 OR (n1.props->'access'->'roots'->'anchors') ? CAST($5 AS text) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchors ge WHERE ge.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ge.src = CAST($4 AS uuid) AND (n1.props->'access'->'groups'->'anchors') ? CAST(ge.dst AS text))) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
INSERT INTO graph_types (type_name, ancestor) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO anchors
                (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
                 src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, version, updated_at)
            VALUES
            (CAST($1 AS uuid), $2, $3, $4, $5, CAST($6 AS uuid), CAST($7 AS uuid), CAST($8 AS uuid), $9, CAST($10 AS jsonb), $11, $12, now()),
(CAST($13 AS uuid), $14, $15, $16, $17, CAST($18 AS uuid), CAST($19 AS uuid), CAST($20 AS uuid), $21, CAST($22 AS jsonb), $23, $24, now()),
(CAST($25 AS uuid), $26, $27, $28, $29, CAST($30 AS uuid), CAST($31 AS uuid), CAST($32 AS uuid), $33, CAST($34 AS jsonb), $35, $36, now())
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
                arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
                arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
                fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
                root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
                src = EXCLUDED.src,
                dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
                undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
                props = EXCLUDED.props,
                format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
                version = EXCLUDED.version + 1,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE anchors.version = EXCLUDED.version
            RETURNING id, version
